release.name: Steel, Electrum, and Trial Chambers
highlights: Secret Ingredient and Secret Meal Advancement
Warding Stones CANNOT be placed in Trial Chambers (try it, I dare you ;) )

blocks.text: While I've attempted to add some support for tutorialisation--I have to admit, watching people be confused, trying to figure stuff out on their own is very very fun. And I think its fun to not know how everything works. To be forced to experiment. Somethings shouldn't require that, like steel and smithing, those should be as intuitive as possible. But I dont mind players being confused, and I think it makes the game better. So, some things, I will not give advancements for (Jewellery, Special Books, Villages, Fetishes (that one im iffy on), etc.), and I think its cooler that way.
ADDED
Secret Ingredient and Secret Meal Advancement
Carbon-Rich Iron, and it's advancement

Wool can now be reverse crafted from carpet (and recipes unlock) now

TWEAKS
Electrum now uses Divine Fragments to craft, like Adamant
Nerfed Blaze Drops (slightly)
Nerfed Frozen Water Effects (No more blindness. Darkness and slowness length decreased)
Nerfed Silver Sword, Warding Sword, and Warding Shield
Tweaked Smithing table texture to make smithing system more clear (hopefully)
Sapling from Leaf recipes all tweaked so that getting the LOGS unlocks it instead of the leaves (Some players were frustrated that they couldn't get saplings, and never picked up leaves)

Fortune NO LONGER works on spawners. I think early game should be defined by the rarity of this material. 4 Fragments per spawner is just too much. After watching some videos of people play this, I realise how easy and elytra and nether fortresses can make it. And as it stands, warding helps a lot with the wither, so I'll need to tweak these things first before I can think about re-adding fortune to spawners.
Removed "F off! in a nice way!" splash because I think some people might not find it as funny as I did, and I don't want to make anyone sad :c
Added some splashes that I think are pretty funny, but I'm also autistic, leave me alone
Steel and Iron Dolabras now have proper attack speed (labelled stat was different than the real stat)
Anvil can no longer be crafted from iron blocks (I dont want players spending too many resources on stuff if they don't have to)
STEEL AND ELECTRUM CHANGES
Steel has an intermediary item now, Carbon-Rich Iron

Originally I wanted to have the carbon cost represented by the cooking time. But wating that long isn't very fun. So I added a new item that still takes the carbon sink, but can be made faster. Remeber, Coal blocks can also be made from charcoal
Electrum is OP (in a good way), and to represent that end-game classification, I made it mirror the Adamant recipe, and gave it the enchanted effect
Another hot fix after I got home from work. I just wanted to try and make tutorialisation easier.

I made a last-minute mistake, changing a lot of the food recipes to make some of the more complex foods use the cooked ingredients from the simple prep foods. This was a big headache, as spawn eggs, even without entity data cannot be eaten. So I shuffled a lot of items around to accommodate this.
Due to this, I will not add any more food ingredients until Mojang allows us to just add our own items and blocks with datapacks, which, I asuume will be done within the next two years.

VILLAGE DETAILS
I want to have all structures given the villager treatment
I think the minecraft world should feel abandoned until YOU come along, so villagers at your base makes sense, it should feel alive. But the rest of the world shouldn't
So probably that means pillager towers will be redone and some other things that make the world feel too inhabited. But Im really running out of time so I just did villages and tried to move on.

We're close to a full release, I have no plans to add new features for the next update, instead focusing on bug-fixes, polish, and UX. I want to get this thing out, that means I have to quit getting excited at fun new things I can add.

FISHING DETAILS
Caught fish have rarities, which correspond to the amount they are worth when sold. Cod and Salmon cannot be killed and sold, only if caught will they be valid.
Freshwater Biomes have been grouped into five types: Cold, Cool, Temperate, Hot Wet, and Hot Dry
Saltwater Biomes have been grouped into five types: Cold, Cool, Temperate, Warm, Hot
Each biome/water type have 5 fish, two common, one uncommon, one rare, and one epic.

Some biomes have special groupings, I want more in the future, right now the swamps are under a special grouping but do not have unique fish, instead currently pulling from other biomes. They do have unique junk though!
This was done to better balance the selling system, so each biome will be just as "efficient" to fish in as any other
AKA you'll make the same amount of money by fishing anywhere (except a few rare biomes)
I pumped out the textures as fast as I could, so some are great, and some are trash (I might have recoloured pre-existing fish for some 🤷 im sorry ik ik)
The Fisherman selling system has been reworked so you have to sell lower-tier fish before you can sell higher tier fish, this was to prevent fish-related "spoilers"
Future Fishing Plans
I want a new legendary fish tier caught only under specific conditions (Raining, night, full moon, etc)
I want more unique fish for magical biomes (sulfur caves, pale garden, deep dark etc) and unique biomes (swamp, coral reefs)

I need to find some way to add a "ping" sound when the fishing bobber finds a fish, but this will be a really difficult task I think, and it may not be possible without mods (I can't find any nbt data for the fishing bobber if it has caught something)
